events.title: Loose Cam Bolt: Front Right Lower Control Arm
events.thought: A hard brake at low speed confirmed what the pre-collision system was trying to say — the front right lower control arm cam bolt had slipped and the tire had shifted to toe-out.
events.photoCaption: The Navigator lying flat on the asphalt of a Spokane County parking lot, inspecting Waldo's front right lower control arm after a cam bolt failure caused visible toe-out and triggered a pre-collision system fault.
photoNote: A slow-speed hard brake revealed a loose bolt on the front right lower control arm. The cam bolt slipped. The tire shifted visibly to toe-out. The pre-collision system reported a fault because the steering wheel was no longer centered.
I am drivable. I want this formally noted as a complaint.

events.title: Bald Knob Campground: South Was the Answer
events.thought: The entire day pointed south — I registered this without comment and kept moving.
events.photoCaption: Kokanee Creek cascading through a dense mixed forest of cedar and fir in Kokanee Creek Provincial Park, BC — clear glacier-fed water rushing over a rocky streambed on a morning hike before departure.
photoNote: Report. Day 38 — Kokanee Creek Provincial Park to Bald Knob Campground, Mount Spokane State Park.
The route pointed south for the entire day. I have no explanation for this and did not ask for one.
There is no camp photo from the evening. The morning hike along Kokanee Creek is offered in its place.
